title: Covenant conformance case
description: An implementation-independent conformance case (or an array of them). Each case names an `area`, a `kind` (the operation under test), a frozen `input`, and the `expected` result. A conformant evaluator dispatches on `kind`, runs `input`, and must produce a value deep-equal to `expected`. See conformance/README.md for the per-kind input/expected contract.

area.description: The semantic area this case belongs to (04_FORMAL_SEMANTICS.md §19).

kind.description: Selects the operation. The runner maps each kind to a canonical @covenant/* API; the contract for each is documented in conformance/README.md.

description.description: Human explanation of what the case pins down.

input.description: The frozen input for the operation. Shape depends on `kind` (see README).

expected.description: The expected result, compared deep-equal (objects order-insensitive, arrays order-sensitive). Shape depends on `kind` (see README).
